name: Coding Agents Service
description: Finds coding-agent CLIs on a node and runs their headless mode as conversations.

tools.name: agents_detect
tools.description:
The coding-agent CLIs installed on this node and the ways PantheonOS can run each; an agent with a headless mode has canvas, what a canvas turn can ask of it (effort levels, research, images, skills, roles, subagents, models); links, whether agents on this node can message linked groups (send) and why not (note).

Args:
    refresh: Detect again now instead of using the result from the last five minutes.

tools.name: agent_terminal_command
tools.description:
The shell command that opens an agent's own interface, for pty_open, and the terminal session it reports to.

Args:
    agent: Catalog id (claude, codex, gemini, cursor, ...) or a custom agent's id.
    resume: The agent's session id to reopen.
    auto: Start in full-auto mode (no approval prompts).
    cwd: The folder, recorded with the terminal session.
    prompt: A first message the agent starts with (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, Qwen Code; prompted says whether it was given).

tools.name: agent_task_command
tools.description:
The shell command that runs a task for an agent in a terminal of its own, for pty_open: install a known agent this node lacks, sign an installed one in, or update it. The terminal session it reports to ends with the task's exit status.

Args:
    agent: Catalog id (claude, codex, gemini, cursor, ...).
    task: install, login or update.

tools.name: agent_send
tools.description:
Send a message to a coding agent and start its turn. Events stream on pantheon.stream.coding_<conversation_id>.

Args:
    prompt: The message.
    agent: Catalog id; needed for a new conversation. A conversation keeps its agent: naming another fails.
    cwd: Folder the agent works in; a new conversation only. Defaults to home.
    conversation_id: Continue this conversation.
    model: Model name the agent understands.
    auto: Full-auto mode for a new conversation.
    origin: Who started it (ui, agent, cli, canvas).
    session_id: Continue this session of the agent's own (one started outside PantheonOS) as a new conversation.
    title: The new conversation's title.

Canvas options, for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent and the Pantheon Agent as far as each agent's canvas capabilities (agents_detect) go; what an agent cannot take is left out:
    effort: low, medium, high, xhigh or max (Codex: max runs as xhigh).
    subagents: [{name, description, prompt, write, model}] — roles it may delegate to; read-only unless write (Claude Code).
    focus: folders to focus on; any outside cwd become reachable.
    files: files pinned for the turn, named in the message; any outside cwd become reachable.
    research: allow web search and fetch (Claude Code, Codex).
    images: absolute paths of reference images (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent).
    skills: names of the agent's skills pinned for the turn, named in the message with their SKILL.md (Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent; Claude Code's are typed as /name).

Linked groups (Agent Canvas):
    links: [{conversation_id, node_id, name, direction, paused}] — replaces the conversation's links before the turn is set up, as agents_links does (null leaves them).
    link_name: this group's name.

tools.name: agent_stop
tools.description: Interrupt a conversation's running turn.

tools.name: agent_conversations
tools.description: Conversations on this node, newest first.

tools.name: agent_conversation
tools.description: A conversation and its events after seq `after`; `more` means call again from the last seq.

tools.name: agent_delete
tools.description: Remove a conversation's record on this node. The agent's own session is kept.

tools.name: agent_sessions
tools.description:
The sessions the agents keep themselves on this node (also those started outside PantheonOS), newest first, with the conversation that continues each.

Args:
    agent: Only this agent's sessions.
    limit: How many (default 50, at most 200).

tools.name: agent_terminals
tools.description: Agents opened in Terminal windows in the last day, with what each is doing (ready, working, waiting for the user, ended).

tools.name: agents_settings
tools.description: How the agents on this node are set up: per agent (hidden, command, args, env, model, auto), custom agents, and whether agents may use PantheonOS. The key itself is never returned.

tools.name: agents_configure
tools.description:
Change the agents' settings, the custom agents, or the project list on this node; a field left out keeps what the node has.

Args:
    agents: {agent id: {hidden, command, args, env, model, auto}}.
    custom: [{id, label, command, env}] — agents run in a terminal by a command line.
    projects: [{path}] — folders on this node whose sessions the desktop lists.

tools.name: agents_access
tools.description:
Let agents on this node use PantheonOS through the pantheon command with a platform key made for the node; an empty key turns it off. Returns replaced_key_id when another key was in place, for the caller to revoke.

Args:
    key: The platform key (pbk_...).
    key_id: Its id, for revoking it later.
    hub_url: The Hub it belongs to.

tools.name: agents_browse
tools.description:
List the folders in a folder on this node (home when empty), for picking a project.

Args:
    path: the folder to list.

tools.name: agents_create_project
tools.description:
Make a new folder on this node for a project, optionally a git repository, and add it to the project list.

Args:
    parent: where to make it (home when empty).
    name: the folder name.
    git: run git init in it.

tools.name: agent_sessions_import
tools.description:
List these agents' own sessions in the desktop, as if started here.

Args:
    sessions: [{agent, id}].

tools.name: agent_sessions_forget
tools.description:
Stop listing these sessions in the desktop; the sessions stay with their agents.

Args:
    sessions: [{agent, id}].

tools.name: agents_workspace_create
tools.description:
Make a workspace of a git project: a git worktree in <parent>/<project>-worktrees/<name>, on a new branch made from the base, kept in the project's list. Changes in the project's own checkout do not matter. Returns the workspace, and agent and prompt as given, for the desktop to start that agent in it.

Args:
    project: the project's folder.
    name: the workspace's name; empty makes up a two-word one no folder or branch uses yet.
    base: the branch or commit to start from; empty is the repository's default branch (origin/HEAD's, else main or master, else what the project has checked out).
    branch: the new branch; empty is <who>/<name>, who being git's user.name (else the login name) as a slug. An existing branch no checkout has is checked out as it is.
    agent: the agent the desktop starts in it.
    prompt: its first message.

tools.name: agents_workspace_remove
tools.description:
Take a workspace off its project's list; with remove, also delete its git worktree, refused while it has changes not committed or commits on no remote and not in its base (the answer says which, under blockers) unless force. The project's own folder is never removed.

Args:
    project: the project's folder.
    path: the workspace's folder.
    remove: delete the worktree too.
    force: delete it even so, losing those changes.
    delete_branch: delete its branch too, only when the base has all of it (else it is kept and note says so).

tools.name: agents_workspace_status
tools.description:
What deleting a workspace would lose: files with changes not committed (changed, the first 20 in changes), commits on no remote and not in its base (unpushed), and whether its branch is merged into the base.

Args:
    project: the project's folder.
    path: the workspace's folder.

tools.name: agents_workspace_adopt
tools.description:
Keep a git worktree of a project made outside PantheonOS (agents_detect lists it with external) in the project's list, as a workspace.

Args:
    project: the project's folder.
    path: the worktree's folder.

tools.name: agents_project_git_init
tools.description:
Make a project folder a git repository, with a first commit of the files in it (as .gitignore allows), so workspaces can be made of it. The home folder is refused.

Args:
    project: the project's folder.

tools.name: agents_skills
tools.description:
An agent's skills on this node, from the places that agent loads them: Claude Code's (the user's, the project's, its plugins'), Codex's (as its app-server lists them), Gemini CLI's or Cursor Agent's. An agent without skills has none.

Args:
    cwd: the project folder whose skills to include.
    agent: claude (default), codex, gemini or cursor.

tools.name: agents_repo_info
tools.description:
A folder's git state: the commit checked out (hash, short, subject), the branch, and the local branches. git is false for a folder outside git.

Args:
    path: the folder.

tools.name: agents_folder_tree
tools.description:
The subfolders of a folder in a project, each with its files counted recursively, leaving out .git, node_modules and hidden folders. Counting stops at 100,000 files or 2 s (approx).

Args:
    path: the project's folder.
    dir: the folder to list, inside path (relative or absolute); path itself when empty.

tools.name: agents_reference_put
tools.description:
Upload a reference image in chunks of at most 48 KB, sent in order, into <cwd>/.pantheon/references. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 20 MB and 40 million pixels. The final chunk returns the file's path.

Args:
    cwd: the workspace.
    upload_id: names the upload across its chunks.
    name: the file name.
    offset: where this chunk starts; 0 starts over.
    data: the chunk, base64.
    final: the last chunk.

tools.name: agents_reference_list
tools.description:
The reference images uploaded to a workspace, newest first.

Args:
    cwd: the workspace.

tools.name: agents_file_read
tools.description:
A piece (at most 48 KB, base64) of a file a conversation worked with: in its folder, or one it named.

Args:
    conversation_id: the conversation.
    path: the file, absolute.
    offset: where to start, in bytes.
    length: how much, at most 48 KB.

tools.name: agents_reference_thumb
tools.description:
A small JPEG preview (at most 256 px, 40 KB, base64) of a reference image.

Args:
    cwd: the workspace.
    path: the image, in <cwd>/.pantheon/references.

tools.name: agents_links
tools.description:
Set (and replace) the linked groups of a conversation on the Agent Canvas, or read them (links null). Linked conversations' agents may message each other: a message starts a turn of the recipient, or waits for its running turn. See docs/apps/coding-agents.md, Linked groups.

Args:
    conversation_id: The conversation (group) on this node.
    name: This group's name, as the agents linked to it call it.
    links: [{conversation_id, node_id, name, direction, paused}] — direction from this conversation: out (it may send), in (it may receive) or both; node_id empty for this node. [] removes all; null only reads.

tools.name: agents_links_release
tools.description:
Let the messages from linked groups that wait because the user stopped a conversation's turn start again (a new turn the user sends does the same).

Args:
    conversation_id: The conversation.

tools.name: agents_link_deliver
tools.description:
Node to node: deliver a message from a linked group to a conversation of this node.

Args:
    message: {id, from: {conversation_id, node_id, name}, to, text, hop}.

tools.name: agents_link_update
tools.description:
Node to node: a later status (delivered, dropped, failed) of a message a conversation of this node sent.

Args:
    conversation_id: The sender.
    id: The message.
    status: Its status now.
    error: Why it failed or was dropped.
    to: {conversation_id, node_id, name} of the recipient.

notes: Go implementation compiled into the fleet runner (this directory's .go files); see docs/apps/coding-agents.md.
